solutionSql:
SELECT id, COUNT(*) AS copies
FROM staging_scans
WHERE id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY id;
ambiguities: A NULL id is not a scan id, so I excluded it with WHERE id IS NOT NULL. No dataset has a NULL id, so the result did not change.
notes: Only scan 1007 repeats in every dataset (2 copies), so each dataset returns one row. Result columns are id and copies.
